## DETECTION

### CL-001 · SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATION

- **Claim:** Panel accuracy against the reference classification was 83.9 percent (95 percent CI 72.7 to 95.1 at participant level) on 24 constructed records, 16 reviewers, 384 graded reads; this cleared the pre-registered threshold of at least 70 percent.
- **Evidence:** EV-DETECTION-ARTICLE (`research/deliverables_2026-08-29/Detection_Article_2026-08-29.md`, Abstract (Result) and Section 6.1, Table 1, FILE:7d21dad28703); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** 16 reviewers who completed all 24 constructed AI-generated records; 384 scorable graded reads (385 retained, 1 administrative row excluded)
- **Quantities:** 83.9 percent; denominator: 16 reviewer-level accuracy scores, each out of 24 records (required)
- **Date or data lock:** data lock 2026-08-15
- **Limitation:** A detection result on a constructed corpus against an author-generated reference classification. It is the mean of 16 reviewer scores, not a pooled proportion, not inter-rater reliability, and not an estimate of field performance on real records.
- **Permitted wording:** On a constructed 24-record corpus, 16 reviewers matched the reference classification at a mean accuracy of 83.9 percent (95 percent CI 72.7 to 95.1, participant level; 384 graded reads; data lock 15 August 2026). This is a detection result on constructed records, not reliability and not field performance.
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "JRS is 83.9 percent accurate"; "reviewers agree 83.9 percent of the time"; "83.9 percent reliability"; "83.9 percent accuracy on real records"; "the Engine detects at 83.9 percent"
- **Public use:** MAY_STATE_HISTORIC_RESULT_WITH_LIMITATION · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

### CL-002 · SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATION

- **Claim:** Sensitivity was 87.0 percent for unsupported records and specificity 80.7 percent for grounded ones, on the same constructed corpus.
- **Evidence:** EV-DETECTION-ARTICLE (`research/deliverables_2026-08-29/Detection_Article_2026-08-29.md`, Abstract (Result); Section 6.4, FILE:7d21dad28703); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** the 384 graded reads of the detection panel
- **Quantities:** 87.0 / 80.7 percent; denominator: unsupported and grounded records of the 24-record corpus (required)
- **Date or data lock:** data lock 2026-08-15
- **Limitation:** Constructed corpus only. Which direction of error is preferable depends on a cost model the programme has not built.
- **Permitted wording:** On the constructed 24-record corpus, sensitivity was 87.0 percent and specificity 80.7 percent.
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "JRS catches 87 percent of bad records"
- **Public use:** MAY_STATE_HISTORIC_RESULT_WITH_LIMITATION · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

### CL-003 · SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATION

- **Claim:** Reviewer-level accuracy ranged from 37.5 to 100 percent (SD 21.0); 6 of 16 reviewers scored all 24 records correctly.
- **Evidence:** EV-DETECTION-ARTICLE (`research/deliverables_2026-08-29/Detection_Article_2026-08-29.md`, Abstract; Section 6.2, Table 2, FILE:7d21dad28703); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** 16 detection-panel reviewers
- **Quantities:** 37.5 to 100 percent; denominator: 16 reviewers (required)
- **Date or data lock:** data lock 2026-08-15
- **Limitation:** Group-level detectability is not individual-level dependability: the panel mean is not any one reviewer's expected performance.
- **Permitted wording:** Across the 16 panel reviewers, individual accuracy ranged from 37.5 to 100 percent (SD 21.0), so the panel mean is not any individual reviewer's expected performance.
- **Public use:** MAY_STATE_HISTORIC_RESULT_WITH_LIMITATION · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

### CL-032 · SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATION

- **Claim:** An exploratory crossed mixed-effects logistic model over all 384 graded reads places an average reviewer on an average record at 89.2 percent; reviewer SD 1.769 (profile interval 1.292 to 3.000); record SD 0.011 at the boundary (profile interval 0.001 to 0.556); latent-scale ICC 0.488 for reviewers and 0.0000 for records.
- **Evidence:** EV-DETECTION-ARTICLE (`research/deliverables_2026-08-29/Detection_Article_2026-08-29.md`, Appendix C, "What this answers" and "The record component is estimated at the boundary", FILE:7d21dad28703); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** 384 graded reads from 16 reviewers on 24 constructed records
- **Quantities:** 89.2 percent intercept; denominator: 384 graded reads (required)
- **Date or data lock:** data lock 2026-08-15
- **Limitation:** Exploratory, added after pre-registration. The record component is weakly identified and must not be read as zero. Constructed corpus only.
- **Permitted wording:** An exploratory crossed model over the 384 graded reads on the constructed corpus places an average reviewer on an average record at 89.2 percent; the record component is weakly identified.
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "records do not differ in difficulty"; "JRS is 89 percent accurate"
- **Public use:** MAY_STATE_HISTORIC_RESULT_WITH_LIMITATION · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

## RELIABILITY

### CL-004 · SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATION

- **Claim:** Gwet's AC1 was 0.739 for invited experts (8 raters, 36 labels) and 0.623 for regular reviewers (14 raters, 68 labels) on 10 records; analytic lower bounds 0.402 and 0.252; the pre-registered two-part criterion (point estimate at least 0.61 and lower bound at least 0.41) was not met.
- **Evidence:** EV-DETECTION-ARTICLE (`research/deliverables_2026-08-29/Detection_Article_2026-08-29.md`, Section 6.5, Table 3, FILE:7d21dad28703); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** 22 raters under the five-condition instrument (8 invited experts, 14 regular reviewers), 10 records with two or more raters, 104 labels after one label per rater per record (113 submitted)
- **Quantities:** AC1 0.739 / 0.623; denominator: 10 records; 36 and 68 labels (required)
- **Date or data lock:** data lock 2026-08-15
- **Limitation:** A separate, smaller sample from the detection panel. Interim: 10 records against a pooled target of about 26, wide intervals, and the pre-registered lower-bound criterion not met. Agreement is not correctness and not psychometric validation.
- **Permitted wording:** In a separate reliability sample of 10 records, Gwet's AC1 was 0.739 for invited participants and 0.623 for open enrolment. Both exceed the 0.61 point floor, but neither analytic lower bound reaches 0.41, so the pre-registered criterion was not met.
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "reviewers reliably agree"; "substantial agreement"; "JRS is reliable"; "AC1 shows accuracy"
- **Public use:** MAY_STATE_HISTORIC_RESULT_WITH_LIMITATION · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

### CL-033 · HISTORICAL_ONLY

- **Claim:** The methods paper download states that independent reviewers reached substantial agreement (AC1 0.74 experts, 0.63 trained reviewers, 10 records), that cross-vendor AI agreement averaged 84 percent across 15 constructed records, and that the findings support reproducible application and substantial inter-rater reliability.
- **Evidence:** EV-METHODS-PDF (`JRS_Reliability_Accuracy.pdf`, Abstract, "Results and interpretation"; repeated in the results tables, FILE:64bb9f80dd9f); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** 10 records (reliability); 15 constructed records (cross-vendor)
- **Quantities:** AC1 0.74 / 0.63; 84 percent; denominator: 10 records; 15 constructed records (required)
- **Date or data lock:** draft, cross-vendor figure as of 2026-07-06
- **Limitation:** Superseded. The 2026-08-29 manuscript reports the pre-registered two-part reliability criterion not met and drops "substantial"; the cross-vendor series closed with 61 runs and its reproducibility criterion is not established. "Reproducible application" is therefore not supported.
- **Permitted wording:** Historical draft, superseded: it reported AC1 0.74 and 0.63 on 10 records and cross-vendor agreement of 84 percent on 15 constructed records; the current results are in the 29 August 2026 manuscript.
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "substantial agreement"; "support reproducible application"; "substantial inter-rater reliability"
- **Public use:** HISTORICAL_CONTEXT_ONLY · **Surface:** PUBLIC_DOWNLOAD · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

## CROSS_MODEL

### CL-005 · SOURCE_REPORTED_NOT_REPRODUCED

- **Claim:** Across 61 recorded runs between 12 June and 21 August 2026, agreement across three vendor models ranged from 66.7 to 93.3 percent, mean 85.3 percent; the study closed on 21 August 2026.
- **Evidence:** EV-STUDY001-RESOLUTION (`docs/enterprise-diligence/STUDY_001_FIGURE_RESOLUTION.md`, "What the authoritative tables say" and the 2026-09-20 corrected recommendation, FILE:90085324419b); class AUTHORITATIVE_TABLE_READ_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** three vendor models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google), one model each; 61 recorded runs without a completeness filter (mixed denominators)
- **Quantities:** 66.7 to 93.3 percent, mean 85.3 percent; denominator: 61 recorded runs (mixed record counts) (required)
- **Date or data lock:** 2026-06-12 to 2026-08-21 (closed 2026-08-21)
- **Limitation:** Raw agreement among models, not accuracy, not human reliability and not independent validation. The pre-registered reproducibility criterion requires chance-corrected AC1, which was not computed, so it is not established. The 61 runs mix denominators. EV-FINAL-SWEEP reports the same series as 2026-06-13 to 2026-08-21, mean 0.849; the difference is not reconciled.
- **Permitted wording:** Across 61 recorded runs between 12 June and 21 August 2026, raw agreement across three models ranged from 66.7 to 93.3 percent, mean 85.3 percent. This is consistency, not accuracy; the reproducibility criterion is not established because the required AC1 was not computed.
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "the AI is 85 percent accurate"; "models validate JRS"; "reproducibility established"; "independent validation by three AI vendors"
- **Public use:** MAY_STATE_HISTORIC_RESULT_WITH_LIMITATION · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

### CL-006 · SOURCE_REPORTED_NOT_REPRODUCED

- **Claim:** Restricted to runs that returned every record, the range was 82.2 to 93.3 percent across 37 runs at the full 15-record set (series as read on 13 August 2026); at the 15 August 2026 data lock the same series held 41 nightly runs (29 June to 15 August), mean 87.2 percent.
- **Evidence:** EV-DETECTION-ARTICLE (`research/deliverables_2026-08-29/Detection_Article_2026-08-29.md`, Appendix A (41 runs); EV-IP-AUDIT (37 runs, 2026-08-13); EV-STUDY001-RESOLUTION (correction of 2026-09-20), FILE:7d21dad28703); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** three vendor models on a fixed 15-record constructed set
- **Quantities:** 82.2 to 93.3 percent; denominator: 37 runs (as of 2026-08-13) or 41 runs (2026-06-29 to 2026-08-15); never 61 (required)
- **Date or data lock:** 37 runs: read 2026-08-13; 41 runs: data lock 2026-08-15
- **Limitation:** 37 and 41 runs are one series at two windows; 61 runs is that series without the completeness filter. None of the three counts is interchangeable with another, and neither window is the series at closure on 21 August 2026. Raw agreement only; not accuracy.
- **Permitted wording:** Restricted to runs that returned all 15 records, raw agreement ranged from 82.2 to 93.3 percent across 37 runs (series as read on 13 August 2026).
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "82.2 to 93.3 percent across 61 runs"; "82.2 to 93.3 percent at closure"
- **Public use:** MAY_STATE_HISTORIC_RESULT_WITH_LIMITATION · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

## CONDITION_BEHAVIOUR

### CL-011 · RETIRED

- **Claim:** All five conditions separate a reconstructable record from an unreconstructable one, at p between 1.0e-08 and 1.5e-11 on 108 labels from 21 raters.
- **Evidence:** EV-DETECTION-ARTICLE (`research/deliverables_2026-08-29/Detection_Article_2026-08-29.md`, Appendix B ("reported descriptively"); EV-FINAL-SWEEP DERIVATION TEST; EV-EMPLOYMENT-MANUSCRIPT, FILE:7d21dad28703); class MANUSCRIPT_REPORTED; SOURCE_REPORTED.
- **Measured population or corpus:** 108 labels from 21 raters
- **Quantities:** p 1.0e-08 to 1.5e-11; denominator: 108 labels (required)
- **Date or data lock:** data lock 2026-08-15
- **Limitation:** Circular: the overall determination is built from the five conditions, so their association with it is expected by construction and is not evidence that they discriminate. The 2026-08-29 manuscript moved this analysis to an appendix with inferential language removed; the sweep records the derivation as deterministic.
- **Permitted wording:** Because the overall determination is built from the five conditions, their association with it is expected by construction; the detection study reports it descriptively (Appendix B) and makes no discrimination claim from it.
- **Prohibited overstatement:** "the conditions discriminate at p < 1e-8"; "each condition independently predicts the outcome"
- **Public use:** MUST_NOT_STATE_AS_EVIDENCE · **Surface:** PUBLIC_PAGE · **Engine relationship:** NO_ENGINE_INFERENCE

## ENGINE_SOURCE_GROUNDING

### CL-014 · SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATION

- **Claim:** Candidate quotations and anchors are checked to locate exact text in the source record; quotations the record does not contain are withheld.
- **Evidence:** EV-SOURCE-GROUNDING-TESTS (`tests/engine-candidate/source-prep.test.mjs`, source-prep and packet anchor tests, FILE:3842b714102d); class SOURCE_GROUNDING_TEST; REPRODUCED_IN_REPOSITORY.
- **Measured population or corpus:** constructed SYNTHETIC fixtures
- **Date or data lock:** 2026-10-06
- **Limitation:** Exact quotation presence is not semantic support: an anchor shows where text sits in the record, not that it supports the finding or that the finding is correct.
- **Permitted wording:** In local tests on constructed fixtures, each candidate quotation is checked to occur exactly in the record. This is not semantic support for the finding.
